title: Just OK
text: Just OK. I got white bins not the color pictured. They are low quality, but will work fine in kitchen and bathroom drawers. Easy to connect and a variety of configurations can be made with the set.

product_metadata.title: Mind Reader 8 Piece Interlocking Multi Purpose Storage bin Organizers, White
features: Convenient 8-Piece Organizer Set of 8: This set includes two large, three medium, and three small storage bins, providing you with ample options for organizing. A practical solution for organizing drawers in your kitchen, office, vanity, bathroom and more

Versatile Organization: These storage bins can be used to organize a wide range of items such as utensils, hair accessories, makeup, office supplies, kitchen tools, first aid kits, and craft supplies. They are designed to meet your organizational needs

Flexible Modular Design: The 8 bins are designed to interlock in multiple configurations, allowing you to create a customized storage solution that suits your space and preferences. This modular design provides flexibility and adaptability

Easy to Clean and Durable: These bins are washable and can be easily cleaned with soap and water, ensuring hassle-free maintenance. The durable material is built to withstand everyday use, offering long-lasting performance

Dimensions: Small bin is 3" long x 3" wide x 1.75" tall (7.6 x 7.6 x 4.45 cm), medium bin is 9.25" long x 3" wide x 1.75" tall (23.5 x 7.6 x 4.45 cm), large bin is 9.25" long x 6.25" wide x 1.75" tall (23.5 x 15.88 x 4.45 cm)
